           LOLEUM TEMULENTUM

         Darnel

        (LOLIUM TUMULENTUM)


Has been made use of in cephalalgia, sciatica, paralysis. Prostration and
        restlessness.



Head.--  Anxious and depressed, confused. Vertigo; must close
        eyes. Head heavy. Noises in ears.



Stomach.--  Nausea, vomiting. Pain in pit of stomach and
        abdomen. Severe purging.



Extremities.--  Gait unsteady.   Trembling
        of all limbs  . Loss of power in extremities.   Violent pain
        in calves, as if bound with cords  . Cold extremities. Spasmodic motions of arms
        and legs. Cannot write; cannot hold a glass of water. Trembling of hands in paralysis.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Secale;
        Lathyr; Astrag  .



Dose.--  Sixth potency.
